> Probe, diagnose, and export MCP server connectivity and capabilities
The `server` command group gives you a breadth-first view of any MCP server — connectivity, OAuth discovery, capabilities, tools,
resources, and prompts — without writing code.
# One command does everything: probe, connect, sweep tools/resources/prompts
If the server requires OAuth, doctor reports `oauth_required` with the discovery metadata. See [OAuth login](https://docs.mcpjam.c
om/cli/oauth-login.md) to obtain a token, then re-run with `--oauth-access-token`.
Stateless HTTP probe — no full client connection. Tests transport selection, OAuth discovery, and `WWW-Authenticate` parsing.
Use this when you want to check reachability and OAuth metadata without triggering a full MCP initialize handshake. The probe send
s an unauthenticated `initialize` request and inspects the response.
* OAuth metadata (resource metadata URL, authorization server metadata, registration strategies, scopes)
Credential headers — `Authorization`, `X-Api-Key`, `X-Auth-Token`, and any other sensitive header names — are automatically redact
ed to `[REDACTED]` in the printed result. Header names are preserved so the request shape remains visible.
Combined triage — runs probe, then attempts a full client connection, then sweeps tools, resources, resource templates, and prompt
s. Returns a single JSON artifact.
